conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I have a Light Blue checking account with you, but I want to swap it for something better — it’s pretty basic and I feel like I’m missing out on better perks. I already moved my money out of it. So I’d like to close it and open a new checking account with better benefits.

Oh, and I’ve also been meaning to open a savings account. I’ve saved up $10,000 and want to earn the absolute highest possible interest rate on it.

Thanks — I can help with this. A few quick things so I can take action safely and accurately:

1) I need to verify your identity before I can close or open accounts on your behalf. Please tell me which identifier you'd like me to look up your profile with: your Rho-Bank user ID, your email address, or your full name. After I look you up I will ask you to confirm any 2 of these 4 values: date of birth, email, phone number, or address.

2) A couple clarifying questions so I handle this the way you want:
- Do you want me to close your Light Blue checking account right away? (You mentioned you moved the money out — please confirm the account is empty and you want immediate closure.)
- Do you want me to open the new checking account immediately as part of this request, or would you like recommendations first? If you want a recommendation: the Bluest Account is our premium checking with the highest visible perks in our docs (2.25% checking APY, lots of wire benefits, ATM rebate cap, dedicated personal banker, and linked savings boosts — e.g., +0.45% to Silver Savings or +0.7% to Bronze Savings). I can open that or discuss other tiers once verified.
- For the savings account: to open a personal savings account we must verify you and you must have at least one active Rho-Bank checking account that has been open at least 14 days. Do you currently have any other Rho checking accounts that have been open >=14 days, or would the new checking you want opened satisfy that requirement after 14 days?

Next steps after you tell me which identifier to use and confirm the two verification fields you’d prefer to confirm:
- I’ll look up your profile, ask you to confirm 2 identity fields, then (with your authorization) I can close the Light Blue account and open the checking account you choose. 
- If you’re eligible to open a savings account now (you already have an eligible checking that meets the 14‑day rule), I can open the savings account for you and — if you want — transfer your $10,000 from checking into the new savings as the opening deposit.
- If you’re not yet eligible to open savings, I’ll explain options (open checking now and wait 14 days; or keep your current checking open if it already meets the 14‑day rule).

Tell me which identifier to look up (user ID, email, or full name) and whether you want me to proceed to look you up now.

Please look me up by email: **riley.parker@gmail.com**.

Yes, you can proceed to look me up now. After that, I can confirm **my date of birth** and **phone number** for the 2 verification fields.
